analysis:
The supplied units are head_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md only (lines 222-603), a documentation file with no code, config, or mode changes. Their claims describe security-relevant behavior in other files, which I could not see.

Claims the next pass should check against the code:
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort and /v1/enroll gating (lines 287-298). Relevant: TB-009, TB-011, T-036, T-052. The notes say enrollment needs a linked provider Bearer token and an SE-key proof. They also say direct MicroMDM enrollment via a copied profile remains possible. This matches the canonical threat model's stated limitation.
- Base rewards now require macOS 27+ and current qualified App Attest authorization (line 292). Relevant: T-055, T-060.
- Removal of caller-supplied top-level user, metadata, safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key from provider-bound bodies (line 269). Relevant: T-003 and the minimization note. The text says nested content can still identify a person.
- Removal of unauthenticated /v1/provider/earnings and the telemetry route (lines 561-562). Relevant: T-031. This is consistent with a closure.
- Attestation challenges fail closed without status_signature (line 563). Relevant: TB-009.
- App Attest protocol 3 only, with pre-v3 enrollments not resuming (line 565). Relevant: TB-011.
- Version floor now excludes providers that report no version (line 557). The note says the live env must be raised by a human before deploy. The canonical context already covers this.
- New cache-routing persistence and cache attempt bookkeeping (lines 270, 463-467). Relevant: T-041 (oversized; not fully visible).
- SSD cache TTL raised from 15 to 30 minutes (line 586), described as a SEC-035 re-acceptance. Relevant: T-041 (oversized; not fully visible).
- Write budget raised from 150 to 750 GB/day (line 504). Relevant: T-016.
- Stripe payout migration (lines 327-331). Relevant: TB-008, T-030.
- Account erasure (T-059). No changelog entry in these units.

No findings were raised. The changelog is not a source of regressions, and this pass saw none of the implementing code.
